about: Field strength: how strong each station's signal is at Finland's outer limit, by Recommendation ITU-R P.1546-6 without terrain, keeping the strongest point.
method: Recommendation ITU-R P.1546-6, steps 6 to 11, 14 and 19, ported from the ITU-R WP 3K reference implementation (version 6.2); checked against its 52 validation examples (compare/p1546_check.ts).
parameters_basis: Field strength exceeded 10% of the time at 50% of locations, receiving antenna 10 m above ground, rural receiver, as in ECC T/R 25-08; the Baltic and Arctic count as cold sea (P.1546-6). No terrain profile: accepted by Traficom on 7 November 2026.
points_basis: Administration policy, worst case, following Traficom (7 November 2026: calculate along land borders and the outer territorial-sea limit, at several points): the 5 nearest points of Finland's outer limit; every third border point (about every 30 km) within 100 km of the nearest distance; and the nearest land-border and sea-limit points. The strongest counts. A path is split into land and sea by testing 60 evenly spaced points along the straight line against the land outlines in spec/tables/finland.json. Paths shorter than 1 km are taken at 1 km.
notes: e.r.p. and effective height come from the Data step.
The field strength is for the station's own e.r.p.: P.1546 curves are for 1 kW, so e.r.p. − 30 dB is added.
